other_conditions: Applicant must have knowledge of the business for which the loan is being applied
Widows and divorcees are given priority
For the NSFDC scheme, annual income must be below ₹98,000 for rural areas or ₹1,20,000 for urban areas
For the 50% Subsidy Scheme and Margin Money, applicant's annual income must be below the poverty line
benefits_summary: Loan of ₹25,000 to ₹50,000 provided at a low interest rate of 4% per annum.
